results.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion
results.original_title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン劇場版 Air／まごころを、君に
results.overview: SEELE orders an all-out attack on NERV, aiming to destroy the Evas before Gendo can advance his own plans for the Human Instrumentality Project. Shinji is pushed to the limits of his sanity as he is forced to decide the fate of humanity.

results.title: EVANGELION: DEATH (TRUE)²
results.original_title: EVANGELION:DEATH(TRUE)²
results.overview: A highly experimental film presenting a story out of chronological order taking place 15 years after a near-apocalyptic catastrophe, about four traumatized 14 year olds who are tasked with piloting massive humanoid decisive weapons called Evangelion, the psychologically maladjusted adults who handle and command them, and the events and forces that affect them or which they take part in as they engage massive hostile invaders known as "Angels."

results.title: Revival of Evangelion
results.original_title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン劇場版 DEATH(TRUE)²／Air／まごころを､君に
results.overview: Revival of Evangelion is a re-edit of the Neon Genesis Evangelion films , released in 1998. It consists of Evangelion: Death (which was essentially a clip show that summarized the entire regular series) and The End of Evangelion , re-edited together to make a version that tells the entire story of Evangelion. It is considered to be the final form of the Evangelion films.

results.title: EVANGELION 30th Anniversary Special Screening
results.original_title: エヴァンゲリオン放送30周年記念特別興行
results.overview: A short film celebrating the 30th anniversary of Neon Genesis Evangelion starring both the original and Rebuild iterations of Asuka. The short comedically explores alternate timelines, with Rebuild Asuka helping her original counterpart make some wishes come true.

results.title: Evangelion Symphony
results.original_title: エヴァンゲリオン交響楽
results.overview: Evangelion Symphony (エヴァンゲリオン交響楽 Evangerion Kōkyōgaku) is an orchestral live album featuring music from the anime series Neon Genesis Evangelion. In 1997 it was recorded at the Bunkamura Orchard Hall. It was released on December 22, 1997 with the catalogue number KICA-390/1 on King Records' label Starchild Records. Shirō Sagisu created and produced the music. It also managed to peak rank 34 in the Oricon charts, managing to make a total of 6 frequent appearances.

results.title: Evangelion Beyond
results.original_title: 「舞台・エヴァンゲリオン ビヨンド」
results.overview: An original work showing an alternative version of the story of Evangelion with brand new characters.  This work depicts the Earth in a devastated state. There are the survivors, and the boys and girls who board the Evangelion to annihilate the enemy called the Apostle.  The show combines puppetry, music, contemporary dance and projection arts to create a unique theatrical experience.

results.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Death and Rebirth
results.original_title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン劇場版 シト新生
results.overview: Originally a collection of clips from the Neon Genesis Evangelion TV series, Death was created as a precursor to the re-worked ending of the series. Rebirth was intended as that re-worked ending, but after production overruns Rebirth became only the first half of the first part of The End of Evangelion, with some minor differences.

results.title: EVANGELION:3.0(-46h)
results.original_title: EVANGELION: 3.0
results.overview: 46 hours before the events of "EVANGELION:3.0 YOU CAN (NOT) REDO." Midori remembers her life post Near Third Impact and how she is saved by WILLE.

results.title: The Wizard Hunter: The Hunt for Evangelion Crowley
results.original_title: The Wizard Hunter: The Hunt for Evangelion Crowley
results.overview: A bounty hunter of lost masterpieces of any era, hired by a Swiss Art Collector is at the end of his tasks. But one last assignment will let him discover his hidden and dark legacy.

results.title: Evangelion: Another Impact (Confidential)
results.original_title: Evangelion: Another Impact (Confidential)
results.overview: Another time, another place. An activation test of a decisive weapon was underway. With its development and operational trials shrouded in complete secrecy, the Another Number - Unit Null, suddenly breaks free of human control and goes berserk. For what purpose was Another Number - Unit Null created? The story of an Evangelion's activation, rampage and howling in another world.

results.title: Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone
results.original_title: ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版：序
results.overview: After the Second Impact, Tokyo-3 is being attacked by giant monsters called Angels that seek to eradicate humankind. The child Shinji’s objective is to fight the Angels by piloting one of the mysterious Evangelion mecha units. A remake of the first six episodes of GAINAX’s famous 1996 anime series. The film was retitled “Evangelion: 1.01” for its DVD release and “Evangelion: 1.11” for a release with additional scenes.

results.title: (Making of) evangelion: Another Impact
results.original_title: (Making of) evangelion: Another Impact
results.overview: A look at the creation of “evangelion: Another Impact.”

results.title: Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance
results.original_title: ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版：破
results.overview: Under constant attack by monstrous creatures called Angels that seek to eradicate humankind, U.N. Special Agency NERV introduces two new EVA pilots to help defend the city of Tokyo-3: the mysterious Makinami Mari Illustrous and the intense Asuka Langley Shikinami. Meanwhile, Gendo Ikari and SEELE proceed with a secret project that involves both Rei and Shinji.

results.title: Evangelion: 3.0+1.0 Thrice Upon a Time
results.original_title: シン・エヴァンゲリオン劇場版:||
results.overview: In the aftermath of the Fourth Impact, stranded without their Evangelions, Shinji, Asuka and Rei find refuge in one of the rare pockets of humanity that still exist on the ruined planet Earth. There, each lives a life far different from their days as an Evangelion pilot. However, the danger to the world is far from over. A new impact is looming on the horizon—one that will prove to be the true end of Evangelion.

results.title: Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo
results.original_title: ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版:Q
results.overview: Fourteen years after Third Impact, Shinji Ikari awakens to a world he does not remember. He hasn't aged. Much of Earth is laid in ruins, NERV has been dismantled, and people who he once protected have turned against him. Befriending the enigmatic Kaworu Nagisa, Shinji continues the fight against the angels and realizes the fighting is far from over, even when it could be against his former allies. The characters' struggles continue amidst the battles against the angels and each other, spiraling down to what could inevitably be the end of the world.

results.title: Evangelion: Hakata - Angel Attack Alternative
results.original_title: Evangelion: Hakata - Angel Attack Alternative
results.overview: This installment in the Evangelion anime franchise takes place after Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance. It is an anime that was made for a water fountain lightshow. An official recording of both the anime and the light show has been uploaded to YouTube.

results.title: YOKO TAKAHASHI EVANGELION Ultimate Live - Tsuki Juuya
results.original_title: YOKO TAKAHASHI EVANGELION Ultimate Live「月十夜」
results.overview: On Sunday, May 28, 2023, YOKO TAKAHASHI, known for singing the theme song of the TV anime "Neon Genesis Evangelion", performed a live concert "YOKO TAKAHASHI EVANGELION Ultimate Live "Tsuki Juuya" at Zepp Shinjuku (TOKYO).  It is part of the "EVANGELION KABUKICHO IMPACT" project held at "Tokyo Kabukicho Tower," which opened on April 14th. This is her FIRST solo performance based on the "Evangelion" series.  Guests include pianist Marassi, who has been viewed over 700 MILLION TIMES on YouTube, violinist Shizuka Kashima, saxophonist Hiroshi Matsushita, and other INTERNATIONALLY ACTIVE performers appear on stage.
